head: claude/evidence-floor-horizon
title: evidence floor: publish how far each leg is from gradeable, and how long until it would be
body:
## The operator asked to fix the evidence floor first. This makes it reachable and the mismatch visible — and the honest finding is that **no window fixes it**.

**DRAFT. The manager merges. Nothing here is enacted:** no leg retired, `config/strategies.yaml` untouched, `MIN_CLOSED_FOR_ACTION` unchanged at 20, review window unchanged at 7 days. Every grade the generator produces is byte-identical. The change is additive publication + an offline report + a proposal.

Full argument and every table: **`docs/design/evidence-floor-horizon-PROPOSAL.md`**.

---

## 1. Populations, before any number

| | what it is | n |
|---|---|---:|
| **P1** | `comms/strategy_reviews/2026-09-01/INDEX.json`, `generated_at` `12:51:37Z` (run #10656) | 52 legs |
| **P2** | the 52 committed packets, `generated_at` span `12:03:11Z..12:03:37Z` (run #10652) | 52 packets |
| **P3** | closed non-backtest trades whose package `created_at` is inside `2026-08-25T12:03:05Z..2026-09-01T12:03:05Z`, `trades`⋈`order_packages` | 142 trades |

P3 comes from a 1000-row `/api/diag/journal?table=trades` page spanning `2026-08-03`..`2026-09-02`; the window starts 08-25, **inside** that span, so it is fully covered rather than truncated.

## 2. What each leg would need — with stated populations

Over **P1 (52 legs)**, window 7d, floor n>=20:

| horizon class | legs | what a wider window does |
|---|---:|---|
| `gradeable_now` | **0** | — |
| `reachable` (a measured close rate) | **18** | **accumulates evidence — the only class waiting reaches** |
| `unbounded_no_closes` (closed nothing, so **no rate was measured**) | **26** | nothing follows. ⚠️ *we did not observe a rate*, **never** *a rate of zero* |
| `structurally_ungradeable` (`execution: shadow`, no fills) | **8** | **nothing, ever** — no window reaches these |

Funnel over **P2**: **18 closed >=1 · 4 filled-not-closed · 7 signalled-not-filled · 23 no decision at all**. (⚠️ My board START said 17/5 for the first two — that was P2's own `n_closed`; using P1's it is 18/4. One row, `qqq_pullback_1h`, disagrees between the artifacts — see §4.)

**What each candidate window actually buys**, at each leg's own point-estimate rate:

| window | legs graded (of 52) | of the 13 losing legs | share of the losing PnL |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 7d (today) | 0 | 0 | 0% |
| 30d | 4 | 2 | 20.2% |
| 35d | 7 | 3 | 28.8% |
| 90d | 10 | 6 | 30.7% |
| 140d | **18** | 13 | 100% |
| 365d | **18** | 13 | 100% |

**It stops at 18 and never moves again. 34 legs are graded by no window at any width.**

⚠️ **And 140d is the optimistic reading of a one-sample forecast.** Eight of the 18 `reachable` legs sit at `n_closed = 1`: point 140d, but the 95% interval consistent with that single close runs **29.5d to 2,729d**. Require the *conservative* bound instead and the table reads **30d→0 · 35d→0 · 70d→2 · 140d→7**. Quoting "140 days grades 18" without the interval is the low-n error moved from the grade to the forecast — **the trap named in the brief**, and the reason this PR does not widen the window.

**Independent corroboration:** the Phase-G sunset pass named 10 retirement candidates with no reference to this model. Classified here: **9 `unbounded_no_closes`, 1 `structurally_ungradeable`, 0 `reachable`.** Two mechanisms built for different questions agree on which legs the closed-trade gate cannot serve.

## 3. ⚠️ The number that makes this urgent is paper money

The measured motivation is *13 losing legs carrying −35,446 of provenance-trusted pnl that no window could act on*. The figure reproduces exactly over P1. **Its interpretation does not survive an account-class split.** Over **P3 (142 closed trades)**:

| | closed trades | PnL |
|---|---:|---:|
| paper | 136 | **−36,219.07** |
| **real money** | **6** | **−3.11** |

The entire real-money population that week is **6 closed trades on `bybit_2` across 2 legs** (`ict_scalp_5m` ×5, `trend_donchian_xrp_4h` ×1).

And **59.4% of the −35,446 is one leg with one closed trade**: `ict_scalp_mgc_15m` at −21,070.00. Verified against the journal — trade `5259`, `ib_paper`, MGC long 4454.8→4405.8, 43 contracts, `sl_cross`: −49.0 pts × 43 × the 10 oz multiplier = **−21,070.00 exactly**. The arithmetic is right; the **account class** is the finding.

`pull_decisions` filters only `is_backtest` — it never consults `account_class`/`is_demo` — so every packet blends real and paper against CLAUDE.md's own P4 contract (*"real and paper performance are never blended"*), which four other surfaces honour. **Filed, not fixed** (`OI-20260902-STRATEGY-REVIEW-PACKET-BLENDS-REAL-AND-PAPER-PNL`): splitting the population changes what the gate decides on, which is the operator's call. ⚠️ And it is **not** a tidy-up — on real money the fleet closed 6 trades in 7 days, so a real-money-only gate is *more* ungradeable, not less.

## 4. Second finding: the committed day directory joins two runs silently

Run #10652 (`c1f95964`) committed `INDEX.json` + all 52 packets at 12:03Z; run #10656 (`7d13bc1a`) then rewrote **`INDEX.json` alone** at 12:51Z. Population: all 52 strategies in both — **1 already disagrees**, `qqq_pullback_1h` reading `n_closed=1 / pnl=-212.52` in the index and `n_closed=0 / pnl=0.0` in its own packet. Nothing stamps that a reader joining them crossed a run boundary.

**Mitigated, not fixed** (`OI-20260902-COMMITTED-REVIEW-DAY-JOINS-TWO-RUNS-SILENTLY`): the index now publishes `n_decisions`/`n_filled`/`execution`/`window_days`, so the diagnosis no longer *needs* the join. The real fix is workflow-side.

## 5. The proposal (§4 of the doc) — proposed, never enacted

- **A.** Split the gate's population by account class **before** choosing any window. The window question cannot be answered over a pool where 136 of 142 closes are paper.
- **B.** **Keep `MIN_CLOSED_FOR_ACTION = 20`.** Nothing argues for lowering it; the largest single loss in the set is an n=1 paper trade.
- **C.** A **secondary 35-day** window published *beside* the 7-day headline, never replacing it — 7 of 52 at the point estimate, **0 on the conservative bound**, and short enough to sit inside one config era. Any KILL off it must carry `days_to_floor_conservative` beside it.
- **D.** Route the other two classes to mechanisms that fit: `unbounded_no_closes` → the **sunset pass** (which already found 9 of them); `structurally_ungradeable` → a **shadow-soak** disposition keyed on signals, not fills. **No window and no floor will ever grade a shadow leg, and this says so rather than engineering around it.**

## 6. What changed in code (all Tier 1, all additive)

| file | effect |
|---|---|
| `src/runtime/evidence_horizon.py` **(new)** | five never-collapsed classes; three-number Poisson interval; stdlib only. `observed_close_rate_per_day` is `None`, **never `0.0`**, when nothing closed |
| `scripts/ml/strategy_review_packet.py` | publishes the block per packet + per index row, plus `window_days`/`n_decisions`/`n_filled`/`execution` and a fleet summary. **Floor value and every grade unchanged** |
| `src/web/api/routers/strategy_review.py` | `evidence.horizon` reads the published block; grades `unknown` on an index that predates it |
| `scripts/ml/evidence_floor_report.py` **(new)** | regenerates every table above from the committed record. `# wiring: manual-only` with the reason |
| `scripts/ci/check_collapsed_states.py` | registers `strategy_reviews.horizon_class` |
| `CLAUDE.md`, `docs/claude/OPEN-ITEMS.json` | the API contract row; 3 new rows |

The committed 2026-09-01 index is **deliberately not back-filled** — it is the record of what that run said, and adding a field would make a later reader believe the run published something it did not. That is why the offline report exists.

## 7. Verification

- **Guards: `PASS 54 · FAIL 0 · SKIP 16`**, run after committing, on the final head. (`unwired-artifact-guard` fired correctly on the new script and was answered with a declared reason, not an exemption; `layer-guard`'s first exit 127 was a missing `import-linter` binary — installed, then `Contracts: 6 kept, 0 broken`.)
- **576 tests pass** across every test file touching a changed module. 47 of them are new, and **the load-bearing ones are the negative assertions**: that 0 closes reports *no rate* rather than a rate of zero, that a missing input grades `unknown` and is never folded into `unbounded_no_closes`, that a shadow leg gets no day-count, and that the n=1 interval keeps spanning two orders of magnitude.
- ⚠️ **This sandbox cannot collect 98 test files** (`_cffi_backend` / pyo3). Verified as **pre-existing**, with my changes stashed as the control — same 99 errors. Not a claim about the full suite; CI runs that.

## 8. What this does NOT do

- It does **not** clear `OI-20260901-REVIEW-PACKET-CANNOT-PROPOSE-AN-ACTION-...`. That row needs a **scheduled** run, an index emitting a non-`unknown` `floor_state`, **and** a recorded operator decision. This PR reaches none of the three on its own — it makes the third *answerable*.
- No committed index has ever emitted the block, so `evidence.horizon` reads `unknown` on every record that exists today (`OI-20260902-EVIDENCE-HORIZON-PUBLISHED-BUT-NEVER-EMITTED-BY-A-REAL-RUN`).
- **A route is not a reader** — nothing renders `evidence.horizon` yet.
